_doc: Nightreign arena structure: full mapping of Nightlords, expeditions, Night Boss arenas, and per-expedition NB1/NB2 pool selection.
_provenance: Cross-reference of (a) MSB Part enumeration across the m47/m48/m49 NB arena MSBs, (b) Sean Martin's PC Gamer per-expedition NB1/NB2 table dated 2025-05-29, (c) EMEVD survey of the v0.24.74 patched bundle. v0.28.x correction: the previous version incorrectly described 22 arena MSBs and tagged 6 DS-ported bosses as script-spawned overlays without dedicated MSBs. MSB inspection shows all 28 NB arenas (including the DS ports) are normal MSBs with the boss as an MSB Part; nothing is EMEVD-spawned.

_terminology._disclaimer: Nightreign uses 'Night Boss' and 'Nightlord' to mean two very different things that sound almost identical. This trips up everyone, including Claude. Keep them straight:
_terminology.Nightlord: The Day-3 final boss. 8 total. FIXED per expedition — pick the Tricephalos expedition, you fight Gladius. Each Nightlord has a dedicated arena map (not in m48/m49 range — separate prefix not yet surveyed). C-prefixes: c4900 (Caligo), c7500 (Gladius/Tricephalos), c7510/c7511 (Adel), c7520 (Gnoster), c7540 (Maris), c7560/c7561/c7570 (Libra), c7580 (Heolstor), c7600 (Fulghor).
_terminology.Night Boss: The Day-1 or Day-2 encounter. 28 dedicated arena MSBs across m47/m48/m49, including the 6 DS-port arenas (Gaping Dragon at m47_80, Centipede Demon at m47_90, Duke's Dear Freja at m48_00, Smelter Demon at m48_10, Nameless King at m48_20, Dancer at m48_30). POOL-SELECTED per expedition — different runs of the same Nightlord can give different Night 1 / Night 2 fights. Each NB arena is an 'overlay MSB' in the map-loading sense (layered on top of a base region at runtime), but the boss is a normal MSB Part inside that MSB — same swap target as any other NB.
_terminology.Expedition: A full run. Player picks the expedition (= which Nightlord) at the Roundtable. The expedition name and the Nightlord name often differ (e.g. Tricephalos = expedition, Gladius = Nightlord c-prefix c7500). This is also confusing.
_terminology.Everdark Sovereign: Harder version of a Nightlord, unlocked after beating the base version. Same arena, upgraded movesets, +Phase 3.

night_boss_arenas._doc: All 28 dedicated Night Boss arena MSBs (22 base NR + 6 DS-port arenas). NR's expedition scheduler picks one for Night 1 and one for Night 2 per run from each expedition's pool. The DS-port arenas (m47_80 through m48_30) follow the same MSB-Part structure as every other NB arena — the boss lives in the MSB; nothing is EMEVD-spawned.

m48_00_00_00.boss: Duke's Dear Freja (DS2 port; +Freja Spiderlings c7810)

m48_20_00_00.boss: Nameless King (DS3 port; mounted on Storm King c7910)

m48_30_00_00.boss: Dancer of the Boreal Valley (DS3 port)

_dark_souls_port_bosses._doc: Six bosses ported from Dark Souls 1/2/3 that appear at NB slots. Previously documented as 'script-spawned overlays without MSBs' — that was incorrect. Each has a dedicated NB arena MSB and a normal MSB Part for the boss chr, indistinguishable in structure from any other NB (Morgott, Grafted Monarch, etc). Listed below for categorical reference only; full arena entries are in night_boss_arenas above.
_dark_souls_port_bosses._note: Nox Dragonkin Soldier is a variant of the existing Dragonkin Soldier (c4650), not a separate chr.

expedition_to_night_boss_pool._doc: Per-Nightlord NB1/NB2 pool selection. SOURCE: PC Gamer, Sean Martin, 2025-05-29 — observational ('here's every night one and night two we've fought so far'), so lists may be incomplete. Article PRE-DATES the Forsaken Hollows DLC (which may have expanded pools). c-prefix annotations added by cross-referencing the 22-arena table.

tricephalos._alaric_observation: 1 in 2 to get Demi-Human Queen at NB1 in Tricephalos run — matches the 2-element NB1 pool.

nb1_pool._note: PC Gamer says 'Wormface' which may be Large Wormface at m48_90

nb1_pool.boss: Tibia Mariner (Those Who Live in Death)

night_aspect._note: Final expedition, unlocked after 4 prior clears. Has the largest pool — pulls from many other expeditions' rosters.

_unmapped_arenas._doc: These two arenas are in our 22-arena list but NOT in PC Gamer's per-expedition table. Either dropped from the rotation, observation-missed by the article, or used by post-DLC content not covered in May 2025 article.

m49_30_Royal_Revenant._status: Not assigned to any expedition in PC Gamer table

m49_90_Ulcerated_Tree_Spirit._status: Not assigned to any expedition in PC Gamer table

_open_questions: Q: Where do the actual Nightlord (Day 3 final boss) arenas live? Not in m47/m48/m49 (those are Night Boss arenas). Probably a different prefix not yet surveyed.

Q: Forsaken Hollows DLC expanded the NB pools? Per Fextralife, post-DLC Bell Bearing Hunter is listed as 'Night Boss for Tricephalos AND Night Aspect' — so BBH was added to Night Aspect's pool post-DLC. Other DLC-era additions not captured by the May 2025 PC Gamer article.
Q: Is m49_30 (Royal Revenant) used in any expedition? Same question for m49_90 (Ulcerated Tree Spirit).
_resolved_questions: [v0.28.x] RESOLVED: 'For Dark Souls overlay bosses — which of the 22 MSB arenas hosts each as its script-overlay?' — premise was wrong. Each DS-ported boss has its own dedicated arena MSB (Gaping Dragon m47_80, Centipede Demon m47_90, Duke's Dear Freja m48_00, Smelter Demon m48_10, Nameless King m48_20, Dancer m48_30). No script-overlay step; the boss is a normal MSB Part inside its arena's MSB.
